# awx_credential_centrify_vault_kv (Resource)

Manages the AWX `Centrify Vault Credential Provider Lookup` (centrify_vault_kv) credential type with first-class typed input attributes. Equivalent to `awx_credential` with `credential_type = data.awx_credential_type.centrify_vault_kv.id`, but with per-field schema validation and sensitivity.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) Centrify API User, having necessary permissions as mentioned in support doc.
- `client_password` (String, Sensitive) Password of Centrify API User with necessary permissions.
- `name` (String) Name of this credential.
- `url` (String) Centrify Tenant URL.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of this credential.
- `oauth_application_id` (String) Application ID of the configured OAuth2 Client (defaults to 'awx'). AWX defaults this to "awx" when unset.
- `oauth_scope` (String) Scope of the configured OAuth2 Client (defaults to 'awx'). AWX defaults this to "awx" when unset.
- `organization` (Number) Inherit permissions from organization roles. Mutually exclusive with team and user.
- `team` (Number) Write-only field used to add team to owner role. Mutually exclusive with organization and user. Only valid for creation.
- `user` (Number) Write-only field used to add user to owner role. Mutually exclusive with organization and team. Only valid for creation.

### Read-Only

- `credential_type` (Number) Resolved AWX credential_type ID for this credential's namespace. Computed at Configure time.
- `id` (Number) Database ID of this credential.
- `kind` (String) AWX credential kind — the namespace of the credential type (e.g. aws / ssh / vault).
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether AWX considers this a managed credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The import ID is <id>
import {
  to = awx_credential_centrify_vault_kv.example
  id = "1"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is <id>
terraform import awx_credential_centrify_vault_kv.example 1
```
